reviewed_notes.description: Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: a Wild-West gold mine, a top-hatted swindler, miners and investors.
Macro close-ups on the key detail (gold nugget in gravel, gold pan) alternate with medium character shots.
Text appears inside the scene (mine entrance sign 'SURE THING MINE'), no overlay graphics.
Warm amber lantern lighting throughout; a dust cloud fills the frame at the climax.
Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept; white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame.
Explains a historical scam step by step and ends on the reveal of how the trick worked.
Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: medieval palace, army, city gate; key prop (bronze dragon jar with frogs) recurs throughout.
Close-up inserts on the key prop (dragon mouth, frog) alternate with wide establishing shots (palace hall, army, city).
Time-of-day lighting tells the story: warm sunset, blue moonlit night, orange dust cloud for the earthquake.

Font category: heavy geometric/rounded sans-serif (Poppins/Montserrat-like category). The exact font cannot be identified from the frames.
Historical mystery told as a mini-story; the final sentence is the reveal (the earthquake) and the video ends right after it.

Story text appears as in-scene signs ('UNFAIR!', 'BOO!', 'WE WANT EGGS') rather than overlay graphics.
